acceptanceCriteria: mapHunks decodes the map with encoding/json, so a compact and an indent-2 encoding of one map yield the same hunks in map order (TestMapHunksReadsAnyJSONLayout, which fails on the line reader).
The DCW-V0-019 trace row names the new test.
body: internal/dogfoodflow/change.go mapHunks (lines 607-645 at b29d35e5) found hunks only in the indent-2 layout that cem prepare writes: a "  \"hunks\": [" line and four-space "{" openers. A compact but valid map therefore yields zero hunks. citationPlanMatchesMap then refuses a correct plan as cem-cite citation-plan-map-mismatch, citedHunks reports zero cited hunks, and recordCitationBinding records no hunk IDs. cem cite itself accepts any valid JSON map. Found by the V1-0019 chi smoke-005 L3c control, which re-encodes the map compactly.
title: Decode the dogfood citation map as JSON instead of by its indent-2 line layout
